summary: Submitted the applicability-boundary experiment for the registered gap: a compact contrast harness (draft/assurance_gap.rs) drives one responder through the same legal leader prefix (Prepare, AcceptSync of six entries with decided_idx 6, forwarded Compaction::Trim(6)) and then the same legal Prepare with decided_idx 3 and an older accepted round, varying only Entry::Snapshot::use_snapshots(). Locally the non-snapshot case aborts with 'attempt to subtract with overflow' while the snapshot-enabled case completes, so the run should either bound the asserted defect to entries without snapshots or widen it; two comparisons (one per case) and their state admission conditions are declared, with previous_id/revision_reason recording that this is a changed basis rather than a repeat.
